brief.headline: Seoul Memory Crash Day 2: SK Hynix -9.6% Despite Record Q2, Samsung -5.2%; HBM Oversold vs. Fundamentals
brief.summary: <cite index="36-2,36-11,36-12">SK Hynix fell 9.6% and Samsung dropped 5.2% on July 29, extending Tuesday's rout when SK Hynix lost 14.7%, Samsung fell 14.4%, and the KOSPI sank 10.8%.</cite> <cite index="40-3">SK Hynix posted Q2 operating profit of 60.5 trillion won and revenue of 79.3 trillion won, both up sharply YoY, but missed elevated consensus.</cite> <cite index="36-14">The crash reflects concerns over earnings expectations, Chinese competition, and whether AI infrastructure spending can keep expanding.</cite> <cite index="40-13">SK Hynix completed long-term supply agreements (LTAs) with more than 10 customers, with additional talks continuing.</cite> <cite index="28-5">CoWoS supply-demand gap expected to narrow from 20% currently to 10% by end-2026 as TSMC expands capacity.</cite>
brief.pair_trade_view: Long SK Hynix vs. Samsung. <cite index="9-3">SK Hynix controlled 57% of global HBM revenue share in Q4 2025, followed by Samsung at 22% and Micron at 21%.</cite> <cite index="40-4,40-13">SK Hynix holds 88 trillion won in cash and 69.4 trillion won in net cash, with LTAs completed with 10+ customers.</cite> <cite index="5-4">Short-term noise around Nvidia's negotiations with HBM suppliers including pricing pushback as Samsung inches closer to HBM3E qualification.</cite> SK Hynix has structurally better HBM positioning despite today's selloff; Samsung still fighting for qualification and share gains. The 4.4pp gap today (SK -9.6% vs. Samsung -5.2%) should reverse as SK's multi-year LTA visibility re-prices.

memory_cycle.notes: <cite index="11-1,13-6">Q3 2026 DRAM contract prices projected to rise 13-18% QoQ and NAND 10-15% QoQ, a marked slowdown from prior quarters.</cite> <cite index="17-10">Q1 2026 conventional DRAM contract prices rose 93-98% QoQ, buyers paid roughly double vs. three months earlier.</cite> <cite index="13-9,13-10">Price deceleration driven by declining willingness to pay on the buyer side, not improved supply; memory prices already so high that PC, smartphone, and consumer manufacturers cannot accept every further increase.</cite> <cite index="8-12">Top three memory makers have already allocated full HBM output for the year, with Micron guiding 68% gross margin in Q2 2026.</cite>

brief.hbm_pulse: <cite index="5-6">HBM bit shipments projected to jump 35% next year to 17.1 billion gigabits.</cite> <cite index="5-7">SK Hynix expects only minimal to modest HBM3E pricing downtick for 2026 vs. 2025 as more suppliers come online.</cite> <cite index="8-4,8-12">Top three memory makers have already allocated full HBM output for 2026, with Micron guiding 68% gross margin in Q2 2026.</cite> <cite index="9-1,9-4">Memory shortages expected to last through 2027, giving leading suppliers stronger pricing power; SK Hynix reported five-fold profit jump in April and said HBM demand to exceed supply over next three years.</cite> <cite index="1-5">Micron's HBM3E 36GB 12-high offering integrated into AMD Instinct MI350 Series.</cite> Today's selloff disconnected from structural demand; hyperscaler capex guidance remains intact.

news_pulse.headline: SK Hynix Q2 Operating Profit 60.5T Won, Revenue 79.3T Won; Misses Consensus Despite Records
news_pulse.implication: Beat-but-miss dynamic drove -14.7% Tuesday, -9.6% Wednesday. LTA completion with 10+ customers underappreciated.

news_pulse.headline: KOSPI Sinks 10.84% on July 28, Samsung -14.4%, SK Hynix -14.7%
news_pulse.implication: Worst KOSPI single-day drop in years. Memory now 50%+ of index weight; systematic de-risking trumping fundamentals.

news_pulse.headline: Single-Stock Leverage ETFs on Samsung, SK Hynix Plunge Below Half Listing Price
news_pulse.implication: Retail capitulation signal. 2x leverage products down 57-58% from listing in two months; forced unwinds may be exhausting.

news_pulse.headline: Top 1% Mirae Asset Clients Net Sold SK Hynix, Samsung on July 28
news_pulse.implication: High-return cohort selling into weakness. Mirae analyst cut SK target to 2.8M won from 4.2M won, citing peer valuation framework.

news_pulse.headline: TSMC CoWoS Supply-Demand Gap Narrowing from 20% to 10% by End-2026
news_pulse.implication: Monthly CoWoS capacity to reach 120-140K wafers in 2026. Eases HBM packaging bottleneck; positive for SK Hynix/Samsung shipment ramps.

news_pulse.headline: Hyperscaler 2026 Capex Consensus Now $690B, Up from $465B at Start of Q3 Earnings
news_pulse.implication: Demand backdrop intact. Amazon $200B, Alphabet $175-185B, Meta $115-135B, Microsoft $120B+. Memory content per server rising.

news_pulse.headline: DRAM Q3 2026 Prices +13-18% QoQ, NAND +10-15% QoQ; Slowdown from Q1's +93-98%
news_pulse.implication: Price growth decelerating but still double-digit. Consumer pushback emerging; enterprise/HBM margins remain elevated.

news_pulse.headline: Oracle Down 51% YoY on Capex Freeze Concerns; Amazon Trailing FCF Collapsed 95% to $1.2B
news_pulse.implication: Capex sustainability fears rippling through memory supply chain. If hyperscalers pause, memory pricing cycle reverses hard.

brief.derivatives_signal: Single-stock 2x leverage ETFs down 57-58% from listing in two months signals capitulation, but not yet bottom. KOSPI 200 futures likely under pressure from margin calls and systematic de-risking. Watch for stabilization in ADR premium/discount spreads (SSNLF, HXSCL) vs. KRX close as U.S. session gauges foreign sentiment. SK Hynix inverse 2x product +29% Tuesday suggests active hedging; if that reverses sharply, short squeeze candidate.
watch_for_next_3h: Samsung detailed Q2 results (July 30 KST) for DRAM/NAND/HBM breakout and operating profit confirmation vs. preliminary 10.4T won
SK Hynix ADR (HXSCL) reaction in U.S. session; divergence from -9.6% KRX close would signal foreign buying interest
KOSPI circuit breaker risk if index tests 2,500 support; Samsung + SK Hynix = ~50% of index weight
Hyperscaler earnings commentary on memory procurement and LTA commitments (Amazon, Meta have calls this week)
Chinese CXMT Shanghai listing overhang; any guidance on HBM3E timeline would pressure Samsung/SK pricing assumptions
